theorem lg_target {n : ℕ} (hn : Even n) : AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) = AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℤ := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    cases hx with a ha
    rw [ha]
    apply AddSubmonoid.nonneg_mem_closure
    use (a ^ n)
    exact Nat.pow_nonneg _ _
  · intro x hx
    rcases mem_nonneg_iff.1 hx with (a | h)
    · use a
      exact Nat.pow_nonneg _ _
    · use 0
      exact AddSubmonoid.zero_mem _
